column6: After a great rumbling, the labyrinth collapsed.
Earthquakes never struck the town of Traujito again.
and the history of Rikistria came to its end.
On the survey team's report, the Republic's council
blamed the disasters on magic stored in the labyrinth,
and reported that the situation was settling.
Some time after the collapse, a young man pulled
from the rubble woke. The people were relieved
he was safe, and the town was filled with joy.
The two holy swords the young man held in the rubble
were then sealed in the vault of the Verdite royal house.
